items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I don't think all of the network shows actually were shown in California. What I'm speaking about is the fact that a lot of auditions for bigger things now are made on things like The Johnny Carson Show or The Merv Griffin

ctx.x: So it just so happened that Pearl Bailey was living in Washington then; although she was working around the country, she made her home in Washington. And at this particular time, she was on sort of a vacation, I guess you'd call it. So we found this out, and the manager very quickly got Pearl Bailey to come into the club. Well, Pearl Bailey, I think she made some sort of a pact with him that she would come in and work for Billie Holiday's two weeks, if at a later date she could have two weeks of her own.. And of…

So Pearl came and she worked these two weeks. While she was there, she got a telegram from her office, someone in California, that they wanted her to come out there. She never had been in California before. And at that particular time, there was no Johnny Carson or that type of show in California. As a matter of fact, I don't think all of the network shows actually were shown in California. What I'm speaking about is the fact that a lot of auditions for bigger things now are made on things like The Johnny Carson…
